description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Physical Mutation

Your skin transforms into something that resembles vegetation. Roll 1d10: 1-5, your skin turns into a supple green plant covering; 6-8, all your hair (including on your body) turns into grass; 9-10, your body is covered by green leaves. You sustain yourself by absorbing sunlight, just like a plant. As long as you have access to water and sunlight you don’t need to eat ordinary food. Your blood turns green unless you have the @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.LxbHm5vyy4pmeYBm]{Corrupted Blood} mutation. You can only gain this mutation once.
